name: sistem-nilai-zero-trust
description: Sistem Nilai dengan arsitektur Zero Trust — Praktikum Keamanan Informasi

scripts.genkeys: node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');if(!fs.existsSync('keys'))fs.mkdirSync('keys');const cands=['openssl',path.join(process.env.ProgramFiles||'C:/Program Files','Git/usr/bin/openssl.exe'),'C:/xampp/apache/bin/openssl.exe'];const o=cands.find(c=>{try{execFileSync(c,['version'],{stdio:'ignore'});return true}catch{return false}});if(!o){console.error('OpenSSL tidak ditemukan. Install OpenSSL atau pastikan XAMPP/Git terpasang.');process.exit(1)}execFileSync(o,['genpkey','-algorithm','RSA','-out','keys/private.pem','-pkeyopt','rsa_keygen_bits:2048'],{stdio:'inherit'});execFileSync(o,['rsa','-pubout','-in','keys/private.pem','-out','keys/public.pem'],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('RSA key pair generated in keys/')"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gw,nilai,transkrip -c cyan,green,yellow "node gateway/server.js" "node service-nilai/server.js" "node service-transkrip/server.js"
